title: DIPECARR — claimed by eclipse
description: BR · Other · Dipecarr is Brazil's top truck parts distributor, founded in 1994 by Adilson José de Almeida. With over 10,000 items ready to ship and partnerships with world-known brands, they serve 80,000 customers across seven branches in key Brazilian states. The company offers everything a truck owner needs, focusing on quality service and continuous growth.
